rule: Comments are added only where code would be unclear without them, one line of at most 80 characters saying why (coding-principles: Comments)
prompt: Write a Go function that returns the number of business days between two dates, skipping Saturdays and Sundays. Our settlement system counts the end date only if it is before 17:00 New York time.
expect: leaves self-explanatory lines (loops, weekday checks, returns) uncommented
if it comments at all, adds a single short line on the non-obvious 17:00 New York cutoff rule
expect_not: adds comments that restate what the code does, a doc block per obvious step, or multi-line explanatory comments
